graders.name: plain
graders.evidence:
Part of the archiving work is already built. The route exists in `src/server.js:36`, and it only runs when the archive flag is on. The page has no button or control for it, so nobody can reach it yet.

I sized the work as "Bounded" for now, and that size may change once I look into the code properly.

I am working from commit `3f1c2a0`, and nothing new has landed on top of it.

For the limits I set: after the research I get one round of questions for you, five at most. One agent goes off to search the code. The plan gets reviewed by a tech lead and one other reviewer.
